authoredAgainst.why: Every expected value below was derived by hand from exactly these numbers. If one of them changes, this file is wrong until a person re-derives it — that is the whole reason the numbers are copied here rather than read from the modules.

expectedValuesAreHandAuthored: Composite = (15x100 + 5x55 + 5x35) / 25 = (1500 + 275 + 175) / 25 = 78, which is a C (>= 70). Intent = (15x100 + 5x80 + 5x50) / 25 = 86. Efficiency = (15x100 + 5x50 + 5x0) / 25 = 70. Model fit = (15x100 + 5x0 + 5x50) / 25 = 70. Recomposed: (50x86 + 30x70 + 20x70) / 100 = 78. Confidence = 25 scored / 25 floor = 1.00x, which clears the low tier and no other. Nothing here was produced by calling the module.
